items.title: What Does Ford Motor (F) Changing Ford Energy Leadership Mean For Its EV Push?
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) appoints Dave Carroll as president of Ford Energy, effective immediately. Carroll joins Ford Energy with senior experience in the renewables sector. He succeeds Lisa Drake, who is retiring after helping build Ford's electrification and energy operations and battery industrialization efforts. The leadership change marks a shift in oversight of Ford's future focused energy and electrification business lines. Ford Motor is far from the only company tied to long term energy...
